_note: Story 10.2: who speaks in a .dialogue file. A line's speaker id is its character name lower-cased with spaces as _ ("Den Fa" -> den_fa), or a [#speaker=id] tag on the line (the Elder's lines say [#speaker=elder]). name: shown in the dialogue box. portrait: the dialogue portrait (res://assets/characters/portraits/npc/<id>.png); while it is missing the box draws a plate in colour with the speaker's initials, or, for plate "mask", Den Fa's mirror mask (a pale featureless oval, never a face). quest_dealer is the staff role desk_manager in data/characters/staff.json. Add a speaker here before writing their first line. Story 25.17: portrait_source says how the portrait studio renders the portrait: model (a body scene path, drawn with its imported look, or with look "anime" or "realistic" anime_look.gd's toon look) or staff_variant ("<role>/<variant>" in staff.json: that variant's model_path and look, so a variant swap re-renders the right body; every staff speaker uses it, never a raw model, and takes no look key of its own); clip and time (seconds): the still frame of the pose; bone: the skeleton bone the camera aims at (default head); camera: eye_offset [x, y, z] metres from that bone to the eye line's centre (the mask's centre for Den Fa), in the body's own frame (x its left, y up, z forward); head_height: crown to chin in metres (one framing rule for everyone: the frame is 2.6 head heights tall, the eyes 43% from the top); yaw_deg: the camera swings round the face (negative: to the body's right, so the face turns to the viewer's right, toward the box's text); pitch_deg: the camera above the eyes, looking down; fov: vertical degrees. Re-render with one command (a windowed run, it needs the GPU; it checks the whole request before writing anything): Godot --path . res://scenes/dev/PortraitStudio.tscn -- ids=den_fa,quest_dealer,bartender (no ids: every speaker with a portrait_source; out=<absolute folder>: previews there instead). A NEW portrait then needs an import: --headless --import, set mipmaps/generate=true and detect_3d/compress_to=0 in its .png.import (compress/mode is already 0; DP-5) and import again; a re-rendered PNG keeps its .import. Story 25.31 re-renders bartender (and quest_dealer) on their realistic bodies (camera re-tuned for a realistic head: eye_offset [0, 0.15, 0.115], head_height 0.26), and Story 25.32 (Den Fa's redesign) must re-render den_fa once his new body lands; 25.11 and 25.12 add the Elder's and the Bard's portrait_source and render them.
